page.title: Connecting Channels
page.subtitle: How permissions and brands fit together, and the exact steps for each platform.

intro.title: The one thing to understand first
intro.body: Connecting a channel is two separate things, and mixing them up is what breaks posting.
intro.layer1Title: What the platform lets us touch
intro.layer1Body: Set in the platform's own dialog when you log in. On Facebook this covers your <bold>whole workspace</bold>, and each new login <bold>replaces</bold> the previous selection.
intro.layer2Title: Which account this brand posts to
intro.layer2Body: Set inside Markaestro, per brand. This is where "one Page per brand" lives, and a brand can hold several accounts if you want.
intro.warning: <bold>Grant everything, then narrow per brand.</bold> In the platform dialog tick every account you might ever post to. Choosing just one there revokes the rest, and their scheduled posts start failing.

meta.label: Facebook
meta.scope: One Facebook login covers your whole workspace. Each brand then picks its own Page.

0.title: Open a Brand and Press Connect on Facebook
0.detail: Brands → pick a brand → Channels. It does not matter which brand you start from; the login applies to every brand.

1.title: Tick Every Page You Want Markaestro to Manage
1.detail: Facebook's dialog is the permission list. Whatever you tick becomes the complete set Markaestro may touch, and it replaces the previous set. A Page you leave unticked loses access immediately.

2.title: Choose Which Page This Brand Posts To
2.detail: Back in Markaestro, use Choose Pages. This is routing, not permission. Each brand can point at its own Page, and one brand can hold several.

meta.gotcha: Ticking only one Page in Facebook's dialog will disconnect every other brand's Page. Always tick them all, then narrow per brand inside Markaestro.

instagram.label: Instagram
instagram.scope: Connected per brand, using Instagram's own login rather than Facebook's.

0.title: Press Connect on Instagram in the Brand's Channels Tab
0.detail: This is separate from Facebook. Linking a Facebook Page does not link its Instagram account.

1.title: Log in with the Instagram Account Itself
1.detail: The account must be a Professional (Business or Creator) account. Personal accounts cannot publish through the API.

instagram.gotcha: If Instagram refuses the login, the account is almost certainly still a personal account. Switch it to Professional in the Instagram app, then reconnect.

tiktok.label: TikTok
tiktok.scope: Connected per brand. By default a post goes to your TikTok inbox to finish in the app; Direct Post publishes straight to your profile.

0.title: Press Connect on TikTok and Authorize
0.detail: Markaestro uploads the media and, by default, sends it to your TikTok inbox.

1.title: Finish the Post in the TikTok App
1.detail: Inbox posts are finished in the TikTok app. When a post reaches your inbox we email you, and the post sits in To post until you confirm. Choose Direct Post on a post to publish straight to your profile instead.

tiktok.gotcha: An inbox post is not live until you open the TikTok app and publish it. The email is your prompt. Direct Post posts go live on their own.

threads.label: Threads
threads.scope: Connected per brand, using its own login.

0.title: Press Connect on Threads
0.detail: Authorize with the Threads account you want to post from.

pinterest.label: Pinterest
pinterest.scope: Connected per brand. Boards work like Facebook Pages. Pick which one this brand pins to.

1.title: Choose a Board
1.detail: Pins need a destination board. You can link several boards to one brand and choose between them when composing.

linkedin.label: LinkedIn
linkedin.scope: Connected per brand, as either a personal profile or a company Page.

0.title: Choose Profile or Pages When Connecting
0.detail: They are separate authorizations. Connect both if you post as yourself and as the company.

1.title: Pick the Destination
1.detail: Select which profile or company Page this brand publishes to.

troubleshooting.title: If Something Stops Working
troubleshooting.subtitle: What each message means and the quickest way out.

0.q: A brand says “Reconnect Facebook and tick this Page”
0.a: Facebook's current permissions no longer include that Page, usually because a later login ticked fewer Pages. Reconnect from any brand and tick every Page. Nothing is lost; the brand's Page choice is restored automatically.

1.q: A brand says “Pick it again in brand settings”
1.a: The Page is still granted but its token needs reissuing. Open the brand's Channels tab and select the Page again.

2.a: Check the brand's Channels tab first. If every channel looks connected, reconnect the platform and tick all accounts. A narrowed permission set is the most common cause.

3.q: A TikTok post never went live
3.a: Inbox TikTok posts must be finished in the TikTok app. Check your email for the prompt, or open To post in Markaestro. Direct Post posts publish on their own; check the post's status for the error.

troubleshooting.manageFrom: Manage every connection from <brands>Brands</brands> or <settings>Settings → Integrations</settings>.
